Villager.trigger: a player claims a power role (Seer/Guard/Witch) and identifies a wolf
Villager.rationale_short: trust explicit role claims over behavioral analysis to remove wolves

Villager.trigger: a player uses phrases like 'textbook' or 'calculated maneuver' without presenting role info
Villager.rationale_short: meta-language is often used by wolves to mask lack of information

Villager.trigger: vote_count for a target exceeds 50% of alive_count based on behavior arguments only
Villager.rationale_short: prevent wolf-led bandwagoning based on subjective behavioral cues

Seer.trigger: result of last NIGHT investigation was WOLF
Seer.rationale_short: explicit claims secure votes better than vague accusations
early data helps narrow down the wolf pool immediately

Guard.trigger: a player has publicly claimed Seer
Guard.rationale_short: Seer is the highest priority target for wolves

Guard.trigger: no player has claimed Seer and round_num == 1
Guard.rationale_short: prevents early elimination while waiting for Seer to emerge

Witch.trigger: a player has publicly claimed Seer and save_potion_available == true
Witch.rationale_short: ensures survival of the primary information source
preserves player count in the crucial early game
